name: Mean Shift Clustering
learningObjectives: Learn how mean shift finds density modes
Learn about convergence in iterative algorithms

controls.label: Bandwidth
controls.tooltip: Controls the size of the neighborhood for density estimation. Larger values create fewer, larger clusters.

controls.label: Kernel Type
controls.tooltip: Type of kernel function for density estimation.

controls.label: Bin Seeding
controls.tooltip: Use grid-based seeding instead of using all data points as seeds. Can be faster for large datasets.

controls.label: Max Iterations
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of iterations for each point to converge to a mode.

visualizations.title: Mean Shift Clustering
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points colored by cluster assignment with density modes marked

metrics.name: Number of Clusters
metrics.description: Number of clusters found automatically by mean shift

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measures how similar points are to their own cluster vs other clusters (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Cluster Sizes
metrics.description: Number of points assigned to each cluster

metrics.name: Convergence Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of points that converged to a mode within the iteration limit

metrics.name: Average Iterations
metrics.description: Average number of iterations needed for points to converge

metrics.name: Mode Densities
metrics.description: Density values at each discovered mode
